# EventDefinition&lt;S *extends* `"country"` \| `"state"`, Id *extends* `string` = `string`&gt;

Defined in: [src/sdk/gameplay.ts:34](https://github.com/maxmixalex/krieg-lang/blob/main/src/sdk/gameplay.ts#L34)

An event declaration that can be scheduled only in its recipient scope.

## Remarks

Country and news events both have country recipients. State events
require a state recipient. The literal ID remains available for native APIs.
